summary: Nomad Power Solutions filed an 8-K disclosing a September 28, 2026 Note Purchase Agreement with an accredited investor for a $6.57 million original-issue-discount secured promissory note sold for $6.0 million gross proceeds, reflecting a $540,000 OID plus $30,000 expense reimbursement. The note matures in 12 months, bears 9% annual interest, and from month six permits monthly redemptions up to $800,000, payable within two trading days. A security agreement pledges substantially all assets and equity, with Lixte and Liora guaranteeing. This is a routine private financing, not a special situation; watch dilution, cash runway, and collateral enforcement risk.
